data.title: Video: Efforts to End the War Continue as Tensions Between the U.S. and Iran Escalate
data.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Tuesday that negotiations to end the war in Iran were continuing. His comments came after the United States conducted what it said were “self-defense strikes” in southern Iran.
data.keywords: Marco Rubio,Iran,US,US and Israeli Attack on Iran,US Foreign Policy,Military,Self-defense
